propositions: Bug tickets lack record of which detection channel found them, preventing escape-channel trend analysis.
The detected_by field must be captured at ticket creation via environment variable (REBAR_DETECTED_BY) or optional --detected-by flag, with env as default and flag override.
Normalization applies strip() and lowercase; empty/whitespace values are treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement or create failure.
The process_create reducer projects detected_by into compiled state present-only (mirroring source_*), and events without the field reduce byte-identically to today's behavior.
All local ingress paths (CLI, MCP, library create_ticket) converge on create_core, but Jira inbound reconciler bypasses it and correctly excludes detected_by to avoid mis-attribution.
